baseline_models.focus_anchor: هَٰذَا خَلْقُ ٱللَّهِ فَأَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ
baseline_models.mechanism: The demonstrative presents an ordered product, then the causative sight-command requires a rival product to be made inspectable; attribution is tested by an exhibit rather than by assertion.

activation_trace.role: Measurement and proportion make the indicated order an inspectable work whose provenance can be compared.
Origination supplies the maker-function that the unnamed alternatives are challenged to demonstrate.
Causing something to appear turns showing into the operational test of the rival claim.
Otherness defines the comparison class whose alleged production must be exhibited.

changed_reading.before: A declaration that God created, followed by a rhetorical denial of other creators.
changed_reading.after: A compact provenance hearing: the present order is exhibit A, and every alternate maker is summoned to produce a resolvable exhibit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَاذَا خَلَقَ ... بَلِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: An alternate authorship claim can itself be a fabrication that relocates agency. When its product is requested, the evidence vanishes, and that very disappearance exposes the wrong placement.

activation_trace.role: Invented speech supplies the counterfeit attribution that imitates a maker-claim without supplying a made thing.
Putting a thing outside its proper place models authorship assigned to the wrong agent.
Disappearance describes the missing rival artifact and makes absence part of the diagnosis.
Uncovering makes the failed exhibition reveal the attribution error rather than merely leave it unproved.

changed_reading.before: Wrongdoers hold an incorrect belief about creation.
changed_reading.after: Their alleged authorship is a fabricated label placed on no showable work; the missing evidence makes the fabrication manifest.

baseline_models.mechanism: The alternatives need not be imagined only as wholly separate gods. They can be near, lower, intermediate agencies that perform measurable operations but fall short of origination; error promotes a link in the chain into its ultimate source.

activation_trace.role: Nearness below the endpoint supplies the image of a proximate cause that stops short of ultimate agency.
The interval between endpoints locates subordinate operations inside a causal chain rather than at its source.
Measuring and shaping allow real intermediate operations while withholding the stronger claim of origination.

changed_reading.before: The verse rejects only independent creator-gods.
changed_reading.after: It also challenges causal truncation: show where any nearer or lower mechanism crosses from arranging what exists into originating it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Purchased, renewing discourse diverts from the path and induces deviation without disclosed knowledge. It supplies a concrete mechanism by which an invented maker-claim can circulate while no rival artifact is produced.

activation_trace.role: Fabricated speech anchors the focus reading in counterfeit authorship rather than in a free-standing theme about talk.
Exchange and purchase make the misleading discourse a deliberately acquired substitute.
Being occupied by one thing away from another gives the substitute its diversionary function.
Ever-renewed report and speech supply the medium in which the unsupported attribution is kept active.
Deviation from the intended path gives the discourse a directional effect that reappears as the focus diagnosis.
Disclosure to a knower, explicitly negated in the source ayah, marks the purchased speech as unsupported.

structural_cues: 31:6 sequences purchase, diversionary speech, caused deviation, absence of knowledge, and mockery before 31:11 demands a visible product.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquired distracting speech, induced deviation, and negated knowledge; I infer that discourse substitutes for the unshowable artifact. It could alternatively distract without directly answering the creation claim.

changed_reading.before: The rival creator claim is simply unsupported.
changed_reading.after: Its support is manufactured socially: purchasable talk occupies attention, moves hearers off course, and stands where a created exhibit should stand.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier hearer turns away, enlarges himself, and behaves as though hearing carried a load rather than understanding. The later command to show is therefore diagnostic: the evidentiary failure includes a chosen posture toward perception.

activation_trace.role: Causing sight anchors the context's reception problem in the focus demand for an inspectable showing.
Turning the back supplies the bodily refusal that blocks uptake before evidence is assessed.
Self-magnifying pride motivates the refusal to enter the comparison on equal evidentiary terms.
Hearing as understanding and compliance identifies what the hearer withholds, not merely what his ear misses.
Weight in the ear materializes resistance as an impediment carried into the later visual challenge.

structural_cues: 31:7 answers recited signs with turning away and simulated non-hearing; 31:11 changes the sensory mode from hearing to showing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refusal, pride, failed auditory uptake, and then a visual imperative; I infer a cross-sensory exposure of motivated non-recognition. The alternative is that the two scenes describe different audiences without a shared mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Show me is addressed to a neutral observer who lacks evidence.
changed_reading.after: Show me also exposes an observer who has trained perception not to yield understanding, so absence of a rival exhibit and refusal of the present exhibit reinforce each other.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah supplies support, stabilization, controlled motion, distribution, water delivery, emergence, and pairing. The demonstrative thus points not only to objects but to a coordinated system whose operations constrain one another.

activation_trace.role: Proportion and measurement integrate the preceding operations into one fitted architecture.
Supporting one thing by a brace contributes the structural-support function, here introduced under negation.
Fixity and rooted stability make the mountains stabilizers rather than inert scenery.
Swaying and disturbance identify the motion that stabilization constrains.
Scattering supplies spatial distribution of living agents across the stabilized field.
Delivering water supplies the transfer that enables the next generative stage.
Growth emerging from earth is the observable output of the water-delivery process.
Joining one thing with a counterpart organizes the generated variety relationally.

structural_cues: 31:10 is immediately antecedent to 31:11's هَٰذَا and orders its clauses from large-scale support through terrestrial stability and dispersal to water-driven growth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered operations; I infer causal coupling and coordinated control among them. They could alternatively remain a catalogue whose only unity is divine attribution.

changed_reading.before: This creation denotes a collection of impressive made objects.
changed_reading.after: This creation denotes an operating architecture: support, damping, distribution, transfer, emergence, and pairing jointly form the exhibit rival agents must match.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated sight-root is set beside negated supports. This prevents a crude equation of creation with whatever is directly visible: effects can be inspectable even when their supporting relation is not presented as a visible object.

activation_trace.role: Active showing states the focus's demand that a causal claim be rendered inspectable.
Eye-sight supplies the immediately preceding visual register against which active showing is heard.
The column or support is the candidate visible mechanism whose negation complicates a purely optical proof standard.

structural_cues: The attachment of تَرَوْنَهَا in 31:10 is syntactically live: it may concern the heavens or the pillars, and 31:11 immediately answers with فَأَرُونِى.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated pillars and repeated sight; I infer a distinction between visible effect and visible support. If تَرَوْنَهَا modifies the heavens rather than the pillars, the invisible-support emphasis weakens but inspectability remains.

changed_reading.before: Show me requires a directly visible manufactured object.
changed_reading.after: Show me requires an accountable causal display; the display may consist of ordered effects even where the supporting relation is not itself seen as a column.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later explicit equation of association with ظلم specifies the focus diagnosis. Claiming creation for another allocates a share in indivisible authorship and thereby puts agency outside its proper place.

activation_trace.role: Misplacing a thing supplies the focus mechanism by which authorship is assigned to an improper agent.
Participation and shared ownership cast alternate creation as an allocated share in agency.
Association specifically with God narrows the partnership mechanism to the relation challenged in the focus.
The repeated misplacement branch binds the later explicit equation back to the focus's wrongdoers.

structural_cues: 31:13 states a direct nominal equation between association and great ظلم, two ayat after 31:11 names the failed rival-creation claim as ظلم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the explicit equation; I infer that assigning creative output is one concrete way of assigning partnership. The later equation also covers worship more broadly, so creation need not exhaust its scope.

changed_reading.before: ظلم is a general moral label attached after the failed challenge.
changed_reading.after: ظلم names an allocation error: a share of creative authorship is booked to an agent that cannot produce the corresponding work.

context_deltas.mechanism: A seed-weight hidden in rock is retrievable, benefits have outer and inner faces, and a soul does not know its future acquisition or death-place. Together these cues revise showing into scale-sensitive accountability through retrieval, effects, and knowledge, not universal immediate visibility.

activation_trace.role: Making something appear anchors the hidden-scale arc in the focus's demand for disclosure.
A measured weight supplies a minute but exact evidentiary unit rather than an indeterminate smallness.
The seed that can grow makes the hidden object a latent process as well as a tiny item.
The mustard seed fixes the lower scale of the retrieval test.
Massive solid rock supplies an opaque container that defeats ordinary access without erasing the contained thing.
Smallness, subtlety, and concealment provide the capacity matched to the hidden scale.
Prominence and disclosure define the outward face of the evidence field.
The hidden interior preserves a real evidentiary domain beyond what is outwardly prominent.
Disclosure to knowledge, negated for the disputant, distinguishes hidden evidence from evidence-free argument.
Knowledge and discernment, negated for each soul, set an epistemic boundary around future and death.

structural_cues: 31:16 nests the tiny item in progressively remote containers and says God brings it.
31:20 pairs outward and inward benefits, then contrasts disputation with absent knowledge, guidance, and illuminating book.
31:34 repeats that no soul knows what it will acquire tomorrow or where it will die.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden retrieval, outer-inner pairing, and human non-knowledge; I infer one graded model of evidence. These may instead be separate lessons, and 'inner' need not denote a hidden causal structure.

changed_reading.before: The challenge excludes rival creation because no rival object is plainly visible.
changed_reading.after: The challenge excludes rival agency because it cannot make itself accountable across scales: locating the minute, governing the inward, and knowing outcomes all count alongside surface display.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later question elicits the opponents' own attribution of cosmic creation to God; the repeated 'besides Him' construction is then identified with a claim that has no reality. The focus challenge becomes cross-examination against an admitted premise.

activation_trace.role: Origination is the disputed function for which the focus demands an alternate producer.
Question and request establish the later exchange as an elicited admission rather than narrator-only assertion.
The same origination function is put directly to the respondents for attribution.
Spoken answer makes their attribution explicit and usable as a premise in the focus's challenge.
Knowledge as disclosure, negated after their answer, marks the gap between verbal concession and integrated recognition.
Claiming a right or affiliation reframes the alternatives as entities sustained by attribution.
The repeated other-than relation resolves the later false claim to the same comparison class as the focus.
A claim with no reality supplies the final status of the alternate authorship assertion.

structural_cues: 31:25 asks who created the heavens and earth and records the answer 'God,' then negates knowledge.
31:30 repeats مِن دُونِهِ and predicates falsehood of what is invoked.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the admission and the later falsehood predicate; I infer that 31:11 anticipates and exploits the respondents' concession. The falsehood in 31:30 can target worship generally, not only a technical creator-claim.

changed_reading.before: The challenge seeks information the opponents might conceivably supply.
changed_reading.after: The challenge is an adversarial consistency test: their own answer assigns origination to God, while their other attributions remain claims with no corresponding reality or work.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation and raising are placed in parallel and compressed to a single self. The focus exhibit therefore expands from the surrounding cosmos to each addressee's own origination and reactivation.

activation_trace.role: Origination anchors the later creation-raising parallel in the focus's disputed maker-function.
Repeated origination moves the demonstrative exhibit from cosmic order to the audience's own creation.
Stirring the still from rest adds reactivation to the creative operation under comparison.
The thing itself or its very identity makes one self the scale-model for collective creation and raising.
Numerical oneness compresses the many-person operation into one reproducible unit.

structural_cues: 31:28 coordinates خَلْقُكُمْ and بَعْثُكُمْ under one negation-exception construction and compares both with one self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies grammatical parallelism and singular comparison; I infer that the focus's 'this creation' includes the observer's own reproducible identity. The construction may instead emphasize divine ease without redefining the focus exhibit.

changed_reading.before: The displayed creation is mainly the external world named before the focus.
changed_reading.after: Every observer is also inside the exhibit: origin and reactivation of a single self are a repeatable unit of the same authorship test.

context_deltas.mechanism: Overwhelming danger covers normal perception, produces exclusive calling, and is followed by knowing denial after rescue. The focus's exhibit test gains an existential form: pressure strips away substitute attributions before ordinary conditions permit them to return.

activation_trace.role: Other-than agents anchor the crisis scene in the focus question of which alternative can actually act.
A covering that rises over and conceals supplies the perceptual and practical pressure of the test.
Interpenetrating turbulence makes the danger dynamic rather than a merely verbal challenge.
Calling and drawing by speech records where agency is sought when action is urgently required.
Exclusive separation from partnership describes the attribution produced under pressure.
Denial despite knowledge explains how the crisis result can later be suppressed without being unknown.

structural_cues: 31:32 orders covering wave, exclusive invocation, rescue, moderated return, and denial of signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the crisis sequence; I infer that it functions as a practical ablation of rival agency. It may instead show devotional inconsistency without directly testing claims about creation.

changed_reading.before: Show what the alternatives created is a courtroom-style demand for an artifact.
changed_reading.after: It also admits a stress test: when ordinary supports are covered, which alleged agent is actually invoked to alter the created system, and which disappear from use?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's non-dominant ر و ي mapping for the focus sight-root, so it is branch-distant and must not replace the ordinary sense of 'show me.' It remains anchored in فَأَرُونِى and is activated by the packet's water-delivery, growth, and rain sequence; downstream prose should present it only as a material resonance about provisioning making agency visible.

activation_trace.role: Carrying and supplying water gives the sight-command an exploratory material echo of making provenance show through provision.
Water delivery supplies the transfer stage through which hidden agency becomes materially effective.
Plant emergence turns delivered water into a visible output of the provisioning chain.
Life-giving rain descending from the sky extends the material chain beyond the immediate antecedent.

changed_reading.before: Show me means only make a rival artifact visible.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material echo, make rival agency show itself by carrying provision through water into growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The water-holding hollow is a remote branch of خ ل ق, so this is not a lexical gloss for creation. It remains anchored in the focus noun and gains a coherent material mechanism from water delivery, seed, and rock; downstream prose should mark it as an ecological micro-image of storage and release, not a primary interpretation.

activation_trace.role: A hollow in rock that retains rainwater supplies the focus word with an exploratory containment architecture.
Delivered water provides the material that a created hollow can receive and preserve.
Massive solid rock supplies the resistant material within which storage or concealment becomes surprising.
The germinating seed makes retained water potentially generative rather than merely static.

changed_reading.before: Creation is viewed at the scale of finished cosmic and terrestrial objects.
changed_reading.after: Creation can be glimpsed, exploratorily, as micro-topology that hides, stores, and later releases the conditions of life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This crosses from fabricated speech in the focus branch inventory to the later pen-sea-word image, so it is a contrastive activation rather than a claim that خَلْق means writing. It stays anchored in the alternate maker-claim and explains why unsupported assertion is unlike authored reality; downstream prose should qualify the inscription analogy as secondary.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَاذَا خَلَقَ read against the fabricated-speech branch of خ ل ق

activation_trace.role: Invented speech supplies the finite counterfeit whose claim lacks a corresponding work.
The sharpened writing instrument turns trees into a hypothetical inscription apparatus.
Vast abundant water supplies the immense but still finite writing medium.
Ink replenishing a pen joins sea, extension, and inscription into one material process.
Exhaustion and ending, explicitly negated, distinguish the divine words from finite counterfeit discourse.
Meaningful speech connecting speakers supplies the authored discourse that the material inscription cannot exhaust.

changed_reading.before: The rivals fail because they cannot point to a created object.
changed_reading.after: Their finite invented attribution is also unlike an authorship whose meaningful articulation would outlast every available pen and sea.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The parent-child non-substitution scene concerns judgment, so extending it to creative agency is inferential and should not collapse those domains. It remains anchored in 'those besides Him' and is supported by the branch image of one thing standing in another's place; downstream prose should state it as a legal-social analogy for nontransferable authorship.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ as proposed substitutes for the named creator

activation_trace.role: Otherness supplies the candidate substitute whose capacity is put under comparison.
One thing standing in another's place gives the social scene a precise substitution mechanism.
Direct generational relation supplies the strongest ordinary human tie, yet it still fails to transfer responsibility.
A determinate thing about which one can report fixes the failed substitution at even the smallest accountable amount.

changed_reading.before: Other agents are rejected because they have produced no independent artifact.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, even the closest generated relation cannot transfer one agent's accountable role to another; creative authorship is less substitutable still.

strongest_changes: The immediate 31:10 antecedent turns 'this creation' from an object list into a coordinated operating architecture.
31:13 specifies ظلم as partnership and therefore as misallocated creative authorship.
31:25 and 31:30 turn the challenge into cross-examination against an admitted premise and a later claim-without-reality.
31:16, 31:20, and 31:34 prevent a naive visualism by distributing accountability across hidden scale, inward effect, retrieval, and knowledge.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustains several readings at once: empirical provenance test, exposure of fabricated attribution, critique of promoted proximate causes, systems-level creation, cross-sensory refusal, and pressure-tested agency. The packet also activated materially coherent but contained water, reservoir, inscription, and substitution outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: The attachment of 31:10's تَرَوْنَهَا controls how strongly invisible support can revise the visual challenge.
The hidden-scale sequence across 31:16, 31:20, and 31:34 may be a reconstructed arc rather than one intended mechanism.
The proximate-cause reading of دُون is viable but less direct than simple otherness.
The ر و ي, water-holding خ ل ق, inscription, and non-substitution activations must remain explicitly exploratory.
